G.” Jackson II''' (born December 17, 2004) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina Gamecocks]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). ==Early life and high school== Jackson grew up in [[Columbia, South Carolina]] and attended [[Ridge View High School]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Article/GG-Jackson-emerges-2023-high-major-prospect-Virginia-Tech-Georgia-Tech-South-Carolina-Washington-Syracuse-149684794/|title=2023 PF G.G. Jackson emerges as a high major prospect|first=Travis|last=Branham|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=July 30, 2020|access-date=November 11, 2022}} As a sophomore, he averaged 15.8 points and 10 rebounds as Ridge View won the South Carolina Class 5A State Championship.{{cite web|url=https://www.thestate.com/sports/high-school/article252202973.html|title=Where SC top basketball prospects stand in recruiting|work=[[The State (newspaper)|The State]]|date=June 22, 2021|access-date=November 11, 2022}} Jackson was named the South Carolina Basketball Gatorade Player of the Year after averaging 22.1 points, 10.9 rebounds, and 2.3 blocks per game and leading the Blazers to a second straight state title in his junior season.{{cite web|url=https://www.greenvilleonline.com/story/sports/college/usc/2022/10/12/gg-jackson-south-carolina-mens-basketball-nba-draft-prospect/69550338007/|title=How freshman star GG Jackson fits with South Carolina men's basketball|work=[[The Greenville News]]|date=October 12, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} ===Recruitment=== Jackson was rated a five-star recruit and was the consensus best collegiate prospect for the 2023 recruiting class. He initially committed to play college basketball at [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] (UNC) shortly after the conclusion of his junior season after considering offers from [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]], [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]], and [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2022/04/27/nc-unc-basketball-recruiting-2023-gg-jackson-commits-hubert-davis/9557017002/|title=5-star recruit GG Jackson commits to UNC basketball with Hubert Davis|work=[[The Fayetteville Observer]]|date=April 27, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/unc-basketball-recruiting-gg-jackson-five-star-forward-in-2023-class-commits-to-tar-heels/|title=UNC basketball recruiting: GG Jackson, five-star forward in 2023 class, commits to Tar Heels|first=David|last=Cobb|website=[[CBS Sports]]|date=April 27, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} Jackson later decommitted from UNC, becoming the first player to do so since [[J. R. Smith]] in 2003.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/34245587/no-6-prospect-gg-jackson-becomes-first-recruit-decommit-north-carolina-men-basketball-program-2003|title=No. 6 prospect G.G. Jackson becomes first recruit to decommit from North Carolina men's basketball program since 2003|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=July 14, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} He ultimately [[reclassification (education)|reclassified]] to the class of 2022 and enrolled at South Carolina.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/34285534/former-north-carolina-tar-heels-commit-gg-jackson-reclassifies-2022-class-commits-south-carolina-gamecocks|title=Former North Carolina Tar Heels basketball commit G.G. Jackson reclassifies to 2022 class, commits to South Carolina Gamecocks|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=July 23, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/insider/story/_/id/34335399/can-gg-jackson-make-south-carolina-gamecocks-relevant-again-coaches-scouts-weigh-in|title=Can G.G. Jackson make South Carolina men's basketball relevant again? Coaches and scouts weigh in|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=August 3, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} Jackson's commitment made him the highest-ranked recruit in school history.{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/3452512/2022/07/23/gg-jackson-commits-to-south-carolina-after-reclassifying-to-class-of-2022/|title=GG Jackson commits to South Carolina after reclassifying to Class of 2022|first=Brendan|last=Marks|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=July 23, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} ==College career== Jackson entered his freshman season at South Carolina as the Gamecocks' starting power forward.{{cite web|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/college/article268231507.html|title=GG Jackson has ‘the hardest job in all of America,’ yet he smiles through it all|work=[[Charlotte Observer]]|date=November 2, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} He was named the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) Freshman of the Week for the first week of the season after averaging 15 points and nine rebounds in his first two career games.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/southcarolina/basketball/south-carolinas-gg-jackson-named-sec-freshman-of-the-week|title=GG Jackson Named SEC Freshman Of The Week|first=Andrew|last=Lyon|website=[[SI.com]]|date=November 15, 2022|access-date=November 18, 2022}} Jackson was benched after shooting 0–8 and scoring no points in an 85–42 loss to Tennessee.{{cite web|url=https://www.islandpacket.com/sports/college/article270945712.html|title= Which GG Jackson will show up for USC at Kentucky? Paris trying to push right buttons|work=[[The Island Packet]]|date=January 9, 2022|access-date=January 13, 2022}} In the following game he scored 16 points off the bench in a 71–68 win over Kentucky.{{cite web|url=https://www.postandcourier.com/sports/carolina/gg-jackson-rebounds-from-benching-with-16-points-in-upset-of-kentucky/article_2fd0e648-91dc-11ed-a4ee-bb004dc8b015.html|title=GG Jackson rebounds from benching with 16 points in upset of Kentucky|work=[[Post and Courier]]|date=January 12, 2022|access-date=January 12, 2022}} Jackson finished the season as the Gamecocks' leading scorer with 15.4 points per game and also led the team with 26 blocks and 24 steals.{{cite web|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/college/article273144575.html|title=Offseason primer: A closer look at Lamont Paris’ USC roster as transfer season begins|work=[[Charlotte Observer]]|date=March 15, 2023|access-date=March 16, 2023}} Following the end of the season he entered the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://apnews.com/article/gg-jackson-south-carolina-nba-draft-d2cf975e36bda0e1d57ea92d1bb5cdef|title=South Carolina’s leading scorer Jackson heads to NBA draft|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=March 24, 2023|access-date=March 24, 2023}} ==National team== Jackson played for the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States under-18 basketball team]] at the [[2022 FIBA Under-18 Americas Championship]].{{cite web|url=https://www.wltx.com/article/sports/high-school/basketball/101-ca48199f-7375-4a59-b7ea-db8f2430354e|title=GG Jackson earns a spot on USA U18 National
